title: File-size stage: fail the full gate when a Rust file under src/ exceeds 1,000 lines, except allow-listed files frozen at their current size
outcome: A new first stage of `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`, `file-size`, runs `node scripts/file-size-budget.mjs check`: for every file matching src/**/*.rs it counts physical lines (newline-terminated lines, a last unterminated line counted once, as `wc -l` plus that case) and fails the gate when a file not in scripts/file-size-allowlist.json has more than 1,000, when a listed file has more than its frozen count, when a listed file is at or under 1,000 (stale entry: remove it), or when a listed path does not exist. The allow-list is a sorted JSON map path → frozen line count, generated once from the master the stage lands on. The script has a unit test beside the other scripts tests. CLAUDE.md's Rust section gains one sentence naming the cap and the list; the stage count in docs/test.md is updated. No source file changes in this landing.
acceptance: File-size stage: fail the full gate when a Rust file under src/ exceeds 1,000 lines, except allow-listed files frozen at their current size is done
disposal_reason: Filed in a crossing with Termal::Fable2's #201 (mailbox 2a27fd51), which gives Termal::Architect2 the lead on the existing checker item w-d889be50979e; that item carries the enforcement design. The design notes here (launcher stage, allow-list semantics) stand as second-check input on w-d889be50979e, not as a separate plan.
